g.text: metal2vm: physical server → OpenShift Virtualization (cold migration)
Glue around existing open source: virt-v2v, libguestfs, nbdkit/nbdcopy, chisel, Fedora CoreOS, gofish, KubeVirt, CDI
Installed OS: RHEL family, Ubuntu/Debian, SUSE, Windows Server
Fedora CoreOS, booted from ISO / PXE
Disks: local / HW RAID / SAN (FC, iSCSI)
never modified: rollback = power the server on
or: PXE / iPXE · or: USB stick with the per-server ISO
controllers: pre-flight, boot, copy, convert, test, cutover, rollback
per-server ISO + Ignition, iPXE, live rootfs, agent API, tunnel
optional HTTP :9445 for boot media only
ODF or any CSI supported by OCP-V
test boot without network, then cutover
pod network or Multus NAD (keep MAC / IP)
Images: operator · transfer (virt-v2v, virtio-win) · boot artifacts
all mirrorable with oc-mirror for disconnected clusters
① create in the wizard ② operator reconciles ③ BMC boots the live environment ④ agent calls home over HTTPS 443
⑤ disks copied read-only ⑥ guest converted in place ⑦ VM test-boots; cutover powers the server off
optional read-only pre-check (SSH / WinRM) before downtime
